note: a fixed server certificate whose DSA key matches its certificate (signed by MockServer's CA): the validator passes and the server context is built (the CA load is logged), but no handshake can complete: TLS 1.3 has no DSA signature scheme, so the JDK fails a TLS 1.3 handshake with SSLHandshakeException '(handshake_failure) No available authentication scheme' after its ServerHello (a TLS 1.2-only client gets 'no cipher suites in common', as Netty's cipher suites have no DHE_DSS one), sends a handshake_failure alert and logs ClientTlsHandshakeFailureLog's WARN.
